environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running Amazon Linux 2, behind a Network Load Balancer (NLB) with TCP passthrough on port 443. TLS terminated at the application via nginx reverse proxy. No application-layer filtering. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. The SQLite database file is on local EBS volume. Flask app runs as systemd service under 'appuser' account.

config.load_balancer: AWS NLB, TCP mode, no content inspection
config.tls: nginx terminates TLS, proxies to localhost:8080
